working_goal_status: Current cwd goal is an older milestone-1-only mirror; supplied shared revision governs this audit.
verdict: Architectural change in construction operators is required: registered 3D section forms and source-specific regional hard plates, not another density/texture patch.

claims.claim: Both controlling references match the shared goal pins.
Head03 improves forehead, cheek and hooked-jaw landmarks, but broad surfaces visibly read as thin slabs with an oversized smooth transverse roof.
claims.consequence_if_false: Discarding useful landmarks or misdirecting the next reconstruction.
claims.next_check: Matched clay render with a grazing light and front/three-quarter views.

claims.claim: The card reading follows from constant/affine transverse-depth polygons, 0.003-0.004 solidify, and only 10-pixel/6-pixel midline bow across broad transverse spans. An edge return joins the bill but does not make its side faces convex.
claims.consequence_if_false: Changing thickness alone repeats the failure.
claims.next_check: Replace side-polygon operator with section-loft construction and compare.

claims.claim: Neck03 and shield03 route plates through a common smooth surface field and repeated leaf templates; smoothing suppresses separate hard planes. This explains regular inflated shingle masses despite thin edges.
claims.consequence_if_false: More leaves merely densify a mistaken surface architecture.
claims.next_check: Render discrete locally formed plates with split normals in clay.

claims.claim: Source registration is unproven: July pixels are affinely mapped to a side plane; render receipts document inherited orthographic cameras, not a July solve. Head full-bird aspect changed from receipt 1000x666 to 1100x900.
claims.consequence_if_false: Workers compensate camera mismatch by deforming geometry.
claims.next_check: Fit separate July-head and full-bird cameras, record landmark residuals, preserve source aspect.

claims.claim: Inherited material graphs on newly generated UVs can confound geometry judgments; bright roofing and black plate faces cannot be attributed exclusively to shape. Exact receiving graph/UV correspondence was not tested.
claims.consequence_if_false: Material remapping is mistaken for geometric improvement.
claims.next_check: Separate clay, face-normal and regional-ID passes from inherited-PBR render.

next_worker_tasks.scope: Retain July landmark outlines, open cheek/jaw, swept crown and source-specific optic placement. Replace planar brow/bill/cheek operators; retain original native. No engineering gate.
operators_parameters: Fit July head camera from optic center/radius, brow root/heel, bill root/tip, mandible tip and skull silhouette; fit full-bird camera separately. Proposed target: median landmark residual <=8px at 1024px, with source aspect preserved.

Loft 7-9 transverse sections with 12-16 perimeter vertices through bill and cranial/cheek volumes; use convex/chamfered cross-sections, support loops and Sub-D level 1 only where needed. Cross-section widths are explicit editable inferred parameters, not source measurements.

Replace giant crown bridge with 3-5 narrow formed overlapping panels; side returns 0.006-0.012 study units, sheet thickness 0.0025-0.004, bevel 0.0005-0.001. Optic cup has real sidewalls and lens center 0.010-0.018 behind retaining lip.
Keep genuine cheek aperture and deep inner occlusion; intersections hidden behind panels are allowed.
render_tests: Same-camera July overlay plus locked-canon full bird, 1024px clay and PBR.
Front, profile and 45-degree view under grazing light; no paired bill cards, roof slab, unbounded open seams or eye disk sitting in front of its rim.
Eight-angle low-resolution turntable and final full-bird comparison; reject any local gain that worsens avian identity.

next_worker_tasks.task: Rebuild coherent neck/breast/shield plate architecture on the source body envelope
next_worker_tasks.scope: Keep accepted anchors/stance and compact flightless shield extent. Carry neck03 fuller breast transition and shield03 separated undersides/cable route only where matched full-bird image benefits. Do not retain oversized exposed shoulder rings simply for mesh density.
operators_parameters: Use explicit regional section guides and source projected borders; stop sampling every visible face from one smooth ellipsoid. Form each plate in its own local frame: 2-3 planar/chamfered faces, sharp crease normals, locally curved root, tapered edge return.

Use 0.002-0.0035 thickness, 0.0004-0.0008 bevel, 20-35% overlap, 0.003-0.008 free-end gap, and 4-10 degree local dihedral as starting proposals; form the surface by placement/rotation rather than a shared pillow field.

Match large framing plates versus small coverts by region; do not uniformly tessellate the breast. Cut visual channels between neck receiver framing, breast and shoulder; recess dark backing 0.015-0.025 and bury ring sectors behind source framing.
Full-bird projected shoulder width, breast bulge, head/body ratio and claw spread are acceptance landmarks. Preserve stance but correct visible limb/claw mass where it prevents matching the source.

Grazing key reveals hard-face changes, real overlap shadows and recessed machinery without isolated giant ring silhouettes.
Regional material-ID pass then PBR at identical camera/light; eight-angle low-resolution view checks coherent construction.
